questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many showed the effect? Your p. 4 and Table S1 answer this for the ten encapsulated devices; for oxidized or etched CsV3Sb5, Devices 11 to 14 appear, and I couldn't find how many were made in total or whether any stayed symmetric.
Why were the others set aside? The numbering runs from Device 1 to Device 16; is that every device you made, and were any lost or excluded?
Which ranges of field, temperature and sweep count did you measure beyond the ones shown, for example the field step in Fig. 4 and the total number of zero-field sweeps per device?

What does the second-best device or dataset look like? Devices 12 and 14 are in the supplement; what do repeated sweeps of Device 11 at the second oxidation step look like, and how was the sweep with η = 83.61% (Fig. 2c) chosen?
What is the residual field at the sample at nominal zero field, after the ramps to 1 T (Figs. S8 and S9) and to 0.2 to 0.3 T (Fig. 4, Figs. S10 and S11), and was it measured or compensated?

At zero field, what are the signed mean η and its standard error for Devices 12, 13 and 14, do the |Ic+| and |Ic−| distributions differ, and does a sweep's polarity follow the sign of the sweep before it?

Were repeated sweeps taken on the pristine devices, and on Devices 13 and 14 before etching, at the temperatures of Fig. 3, and how do the geometry, critical current and number of sweeps of Ti-doped Devices 15 and 16 compare with Devices 12 and 13?

Which device does each supplementary figure show, and how was the onset current defined in the multi-peak traces? Fig. S3 calls Device 12 "Fig. 2 in the main text" while Fig. 2 shows Device 11, Fig. S4 is labelled Device 13 "after successive oxidation stages" yet appears to carry the −30.86% and 17.07% values p. 5 gives for Device 12, and Table S1 lists Devices 2 to 10.
